title: Daily briefing: The mystery of the ‘little red dots’
abstract: Theories abound about the identity of these enigmatic objects in space. Plus, meet a nation’s favourite goth robin and discover benefits associated with a low-sugar babyhood.
abstract_zh: 关于这些神秘空间物体身份的理论层出不穷。此外，认识一下全国最爱的哥特式罗宾，并发现低糖婴儿期的益处。
